technical_summary: Generative voice-cloning was used to mimic a family member's voice in a scripted kidnapping-ransom phone call. The scammers combined the synthetic voice with coached instructions and psychological pressure so the victim would send a wire transfer.

summary: Spanish authorities say a man arrested near Barcelona used AI tools to edit images into jihadist propaganda that he spread on social media and encrypted apps. The reports do not show an attack resulted.
